title: penstemon richardsonii var. dentatus
intro: Penstemon richardsonii var. dentatus, commonly known as Richardson's Beardtongue, is a variety of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Penstemon richardsonii var. dentatus include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
